title: 2Y CSI 1000 snowball: gamma pin-risk techniques and SOPs
book_notes: ki75 is the product, sampled by the headline and pin sets; seas6 is the same 75% product in its last 6 months (18 months elapsed, coupon accrued over the full 24, not knocked in), booked on the first anchored chain day of each ISO week with its KI barrier 7% below the booking-day spot, because the knock-in pin is a property of a short remaining life; KO pin events are measured on ki75 only; seas6 is not given a coupon of its own: it carries the ki75 coupon of its booking day (the coupon a fresh note would have been sold with that day is not solved again); its cash is seasoned: a KO at an observation t years after booking pays coupon x (1.5 + t) x notional, a maturity without knock-in pays coupon x (1.5 + T) x notional with T the rolled maturity in years (about 2 years of coupon, not exactly 2.0), and a knocked-in maturity is the standard put loss on the strike

note.coupon: solved to PV = 0 under hold_forward at inception, shared by every technique
note.engine: SnowballQuadEngineV2 defaults, flat vol = the day's far-MO ATM vol

clock_notes.close: every trade fills at the day's close (IM close, MO settlement): the 14:55 day-end order proxy
clock_notes.twap: every trade fills at the day VWAP (turnover / volume / multiplier), close at zero volume; a VWAP proxy for a TWAP order; trade size comes from the close, so it is correlated with close minus VWAP
clock_notes.next_open: as close, except on fixing days: no IM trade at the fixing close, the adjustment fills at the next IM open and option legs at the next settlement

models.ko_direction: sign of gap_ko on the first KO-window day of each observation, kept for that observation

overlay.scenario_move: one daily sigma either side of the barrier

statistics.p_definition: share of replicates with ES10(technique) - ES10(base) <= 0
statistics.multiplicity: raw p decides; Holm-adjusted p across eligible KO rows is printed beside it

verdict.tail: ES10 higher than base, worst event not lower, p < p_max, on test events under the primary clock
verdict.whole_life_set: unselected notes of the same book (ki75 headline set; every seas6 booking), day-0 row left out
verdict.robust: also passes the tail test under twap and next_open
verdict.ki_transfer: the seas6 training picks are reported on the ki75 test approaches without a verdict; the ki75 rows rest on two episodes with a long life left

event_windows.ko: daily rows from the first trading day with the observation at most 10 trading days ahead through the trading day after it
event_windows.ki: daily rows from the first day of the approach through the trading day after its last day

amendments.text: added the lifted-KI books ki85 and ki90 and moved the KI verdict to ki90 (was: descriptive only on ki75); narrowed the KI window from 10% to 5% above the barrier; added H8; lifted books sample 3 notes per ISO week of approach date

dropped the lifted-KI books ki85 and ki90 because they hold no knock-in pin: for a fresh note 3% above its KI barrier the gap between the not-knocked-in and the knocked-in price is 8.6 bp of notional at a 75% barrier with 24 months left and 384.2 bp with 3 months left, and at 85% and 90% it is zero beyond 12 months (85%: 1.9 bp at 12 months, 0.1 bp at 18, 0.0 at 24; 90%: 0.0 bp at 12, 18 and 24 months): with a long life left a note near its barrier knocks in later anyway, so being knocked in today is worth nothing. Replaced them by the seasoned book seas6 (the 75% product with 18 months elapsed and 6 left, booked weekly, KI barrier 7% below the booking-day spot), on which the KI verdict now rests; ki75 stays the KO book and the KI transfer check

deviation_protocol: a defect found after test numbers have been seen is fixed, training selection and the test are re-run, and the README lists the headline numbers before and after; grid and thresholds are never changed after unblinding

hypotheses.text: surv_hold improves the KO event tail by more than any shift, spread or bend of up to 3%
techniques that improve the tail do not lower the whole-life daily standard deviation, and may raise it
mo_ko improves the KO tail by more than any futures-only rule when the series expires within two trading days of the observation, less with a longer gap; at a 500 mio desk book it is partly unfilled
at KI, ki_cap and ki_shift move the tail in opposite directions; no prior on which is better
the wrong-way controls are worse than the baseline on the tail
the ranking is the same under close and twap fills; next_open widens the gaps without changing the order
gap_ko is positive on the large majority of KO-window observations
the ranking of the KI rules on the seasoned book (seas6) is the same as on the 2Y product's own approaches (ki75)
